text: A strategy enters by having its rule, market, data version, parameters and minimum-bet threshold frozen in the library before it is evaluated. A rule changed after evaluation is a new strategy with a new id.
S = single bets (spread, total, moneyline). P = parlays, built only from simultaneous-kickoff slates. X = player-prop combinations, which currently hold no verified price history.
Lines and picks are hashed into an append-only ledger before kickoff. Grading is against official NFL finals only. A result that was not frozen before kickoff cannot earn a tier.
Rank on gates passed first, then on sample size. Profit alone never decides a rank: a leaderboard sorted by raw return ranks variance, not skill.
Reward follows the ladder below. No tier above T3 can be awarded while gate G1 fails, because no authenticated executable price exists to measure the return against.
Selective reporting, fabricated quotes, undisclosed rule changes, or deleting losing trials is disqualification (Tier DQ), permanently, for that strategy id.
Every candidate is published, including failures and including this page's blank cells. A blank cell means the evidence is missing; it is never a zero.
